Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Korah_3: son of Izhar (Exodus 6:21) who rebelled against God and Moses (Numbers chapter 16)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Samuel_2: son of Elkanah and Hannah (1 Samuel 1:20)
Kish_1: a mighty man of valor [perhaps wealth or influence] (1 Samuel 9:1)
Saul_1: son of Kish (1 Samuel 9:2), King of Israel (1 Samuel 11:15)
Abner_1: captain of Saul's army and Saul's uncle (1 Samuel 14:50)
Zeruiah_1: mother of Abishai, Joab (1 Samuel 26:6), and Asahel (2 Samuel 2:18), sister of King David (1 Chronicles 2:16)
Joab_1: son of Zeruiah (2 Samuel 2:13), commander of David's army (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Shallum_7: one of the gatekeepers (1 Chronicles 9:17), to the east (1 Chronicles 26:14), gatekeeper (Ezra 2:42, Nehemiah 7:45, Nehemiah 12:25)
Kore_1: father of Shallum, descendant of Korah (1 Chronicles 9:19)
Joel_6: chief of the sons of Gershom (1 Chronicles 15:7), son of Ladan (1 Chronicles 23:8)
Zechariah_5: second rank Levite, gatekeeper (1 Chronicles 15:18), a trumpeter (1 Chronicles 15:24)
Jehiel_1: second rank Levite, gatekeeper (1 Chronicles 15:18), son of Ladan [Libni_1] (1 Chronicles 23:8)
Obed-edom_2: second rank Levite, gatekeeper (1 Chronicles 15:18), the south gate (1 Chronicles 26:15)
Chenaniah_1: chief of the Levites (1 Chronicles 15:22), descendant of Izhar (1 Chronicles 26:29)
Hosah_1: one of the gatekeepers (1 Chronicles 16:38), to the west (1 Chronicles 26:16)
Shebuel_1: descendant of Gershom (1 Chronicles 23:16), officer over the treasures (1 Chronicles 26:24)
Jeriah_1: descendant of Hebron (1 Chronicles 23:19), chief among the Hebronites from Jazer of Gilead (1 Chronicles 26:31)
Isshiah_4: son of Rehabiah, son of Eliezer, son of Moses (1 Chronicles 24:21)
Mattithiah_3: son of Jeduthun (1 Chronicles 25:3), chosen fourteenth by lot (1 Chronicles 25:21)
Elihu_3: son of Shemaiah [Shemaiah_9], a valiant man (1 Chronicles 26:7)
Semachiah_1: son of Shemaiah [Shemaiah_9], a valiant man (1 Chronicles 26:7)
Shimri_3: son of Hosah- made firstborn (1 Chronicles 26:10)
Shelomoth_2: son of Zichri (1 Chronicles 26:25)- had charge of treasures and gifts from David and others (1 Chronicles 26:26)
